tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a whois lookup or a domain lookup: which registrar holds this domain, the domain expiration date, when does my domain expire, a domain registrar lookup, the domain age, the nameservers, or to check domain expiry for up to 20 domains at once. Reads live RDAP registry data

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_domain" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
